tool_input.summary: Fixed uncaught ENOENT exception when sidecar binary (coda) is not found. Added sidecar.on('error') handler in startSidecar() to gracefully handle spawn failures instead of crashing the Electron app with an uncaught exception dialog.

event.last_assistant_message: The fix: added a `sidecar.on("error", ...)` handler in [main.ts:102](semio-coda/desktop/main.ts#L102). The `spawn()` call emits an `error` event when the binary isn't found (ENOENT), but without a handler it becomes an uncaught exception that crashes Electron. Now it logs the error and calls `cleanup()` gracefully, so the app continues to work without the sidecar.
